worklogs.comment:
# *Setup & Learned Elasticsearch 9.x*
#* Understood basic concepts: Cluster, Node, Index, Document.
#* Installed Elasticsearch and Kibana via Docker.
# *Integrated Elasticsearch with .NET*
#* Used {{Elastic.Clients.Elasticsearch}} NuGet package for modern, strong-typed access.

# *Defined an Audit Log Data Model*
#* Created {{AuditLogEntry}} DTO with: Entity, EntityId, Field, Action, OldValue, NewValue, User, Timestamp.
# *Captured Changes from EF Core*
#* Built an extension method ({{CaptureAuditLogEntries}}) to extract all changes per Save (create/update/delete).
#* Ensured changes are captured for all entities and tables in a generic, reusable way.
# *Implemented Fire-and-Forget Logging*
#* Built a background queue ({{IAuditLogQueue}} + implementation) so audit logging does NOT block main DB saves.
#* Used batch (bulk) indexing for performance and reliability.
# *ElasticSearch Bulk Indexing per Entity*
#* Logs stored in per-entity indices (e.g., {{auditlog-company}}, {{auditlog-calender}}).
#* Enables fast, filtered queries by {{EntityId}} for any entity/table.
# *Query Audit History Efficiently*
#* Added service method to fetch audit history by entity and master ID.
#* Supported robust querying compatible with various field mappings.
# *Diagnosed and Fixed Field Mapping Issues*
#* Verified data and mappings in Kibana Dev Tools.
#* Adjusted query style ({{term}} vs {{match}}) for best compatibility.
# *Kibana Integration*
#* Set up index patterns and discovered logs in Kibana UI.
#* Used Dev Tools for advanced troubleshooting.

* Arranged and participated in a meeting to discuss strategies for integrating Elasticsearch indexing and data insertion with the team.
* Collected requirements and clarifications from TL, especially regarding logging behavior: specifically, logging directly to Elasticsearch rather than relying on EF Core’s {{SaveChanges}}.
* Began prototyping a method to capture and log request and response data for API endpoints, aligning with new requirements (not using old methods for historical logs).

* Focused on implementing and testing audit log capture for several endpoints, specifically around Calendar and Holiday modules.
* Ongoing: Working to resolve blockers in request/response logging and optimizing the logging workflow per the discussed strategy.

# *Deep-dive Research on Elasticsearch Audit Logging*
#* Compared best practices for index-per-entity vs index-per-page audit log design.
#* Validated that using one index per entity/page is optimal for ERP audit logs.
# *Elasticsearch Index/Mapping Analysis* 
#* Analyzed existing Elasticsearch index mappings using Kibana Dev Tools.
#* Investigated mapping conflicts, especially object vs string issues (e.g., {{"path"}} field).
#* Verified correct storage of {{entityId}}, {{requestBody}}, and {{responseBody}} fields.
# *Elasticsearch Query Troubleshooting & R&D* 
#* Tested multiple query types ({{term}}, {{match}}) against stored audit log data.
#* Identified root cause of empty search results due to mapping differences (e.g., {{entityId}} as {{text}}).
#* Documented query strategies based on mapping ({{.keyword}} vs direct field).
# *.NET Integration & Code Refactoring* 
#* Refactored the logging pipeline to use a single index per page/entity for audit logs.
#* Implemented new {{IndexSingleLogAsync}} and {{GetHistoryAsync}} methods for efficient storage and retrieval.
#* Ensured all audit logs include a stable {{entityId}} property for history search.
# *Serialization and Data Consistency Fixes* 
#* Identified and resolved issues where {{requestBody}}/{{responseBody}} were being stored as JSON strings, not objects.
#* Improved log object building in .NET to guarantee properties are stored as structured objects for Elasticsearch, not as JSON strings.
# *Mapping Conflict Resolution* 
#* Debugged and fixed mapping conflict with the {{"path"}} field (object vs string).
#* Documented solution: all future logs must use a consistent type for {{"path"}}; index recreation if type needs to change.
# *Testing & Verification in Kibana* 
#* Indexed sample logs and confirmed data format using Kibana Dev Tools.
#* Verified document structure, field names, and query behavior.
# *Discussion & Documentation* 
#* Discussed blockers and findings on storing request/response bodies.
#* Documented design decisions, best practices, and limitations (e.g., Elasticsearch does not support dynamic field type changes).

----

h3. *Pending/Blockers*

* *[BLOCKER]* Current implementation saves {{requestBody}} and {{responseBody}} as JSON strings, not objects, due to C# serialization limitations with anonymous/dynamic types.
** Need further R&D or refactor to always store these fields as structured objects for better query and usability.
** *Solution options:*
*** Use strongly-typed DTOs instead of anonymous objects.
*** Update log creation to avoid double-serialization.
* *HistoryService Refactoring (In Progress)*
** Major refactoring required to handle new audit log structure.
** Must support deserializing stored JSON strings for backward compatibility.
** Further work needed to adapt the retrieval logic and parsing in the UI/service layer.
* *Index Mapping Cleanup*
** Pending: Plan for index re-creation or mapping templates to ensure future fields (like {{path}}) are consistently typed.

*Note:*
The code implemented during this R&D phase is intended as a proof-of-concept/sample and does not fully follow company coding standards or best practices.

My primary goal was to validate the end-to-end integration of Elasticsearch and the new audit/history logging workflow, ensure correct data flow, and identify/eliminate major blockers.

fields.description:
Implement drag-and-drop support for adding lines into the Report Builder designer area. Users should be able to select a line element from the component toolbox and drag it into the design canvas. Once dropped, the line should become fully interactive, supporting all standard functionalities such as resizing, repositioning, and styling adjustments. This feature enhances the user experience by enabling more intuitive and flexible layout design within the report builder interface.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Users can drag a line from the toolbox into the designer area.
* The line appears at the drop location with default styling.
* The line can be resized horizontally and/or vertically, depending on its orientation.
* The line can be repositioned within the designer area after being dropped.
* The line supports standard design-time properties, including:
** Position (left, top)
** Line color
** Line thickness (weight)
** Line style (solid, dashed, dotted, etc.)
** Orientation (horizontal or vertical)
** Layer order (z-index or bring to front/send to back)
** Element can be deleted when selected and press delete button or click on the delete icon in the toolbar

fields.description:
Task Overview : 

The user who is in the approver end , i must be able to Revert the approval to the previous user or previous level.

User Story : 

# As a user (Approver ), i must be given with the specific button to revert the approval directly to the previous user or the previous, so that i can execute the action with just one click.
# Assystem , system must ask for the type of revert (User level or State level), so that user can select the type
# As system , the system must pull down the document to the previous state or to the user based on the selection , so that the document will be rechecked
# As system , the system must revert the document to the previous immediate user who gave the approval if the selection is user (when multiple participants are in the approval), so that the user will recheck
# As system , the system must revert the document to the previous immediate state where the document was previously landed, so that the users in that particular status  will recheck
# As system , the system must always ask for the comment to put, so that the revert reason must be visible to the users 
# As system , the system must always ask for the confirmation to execute, so that the execution will be completed with the consent of the user

fields.description:
*Problem Overview :* 

As per the current implementation , the user who requests for approval or execution all know is the statuses not the progress. This gives a confusion to the user about the review by the approver.

*Proposed Solution :* 

If there is a button given to the approver to indicate that the document under review , this problem can be overcome.

# As system , the system must enable the Action drop down only of the Review Indication toggle enabled, so that we can make sure that the approval is given only after the review.
# This is applicable for all the order types (At least one/Sequentially and Non Sequentially everyone)
# If the toggle is enabled , the user who created the document must be shown as REVIEW INPROGRESS as status with a default colour code

fields.description:
*As a* user of the Report Builder,
*I want* to drag UI widgets (Text, Line, Table, etc.) from the left toolbox panel into the designer area,
*So that* I can design and customize my report layout visually.

h3. *Task Description:*

* Display a *Toolbox Panel* on the left side of the Report Builder UI.
* Include the following *widgets/icons* in the Toolbox:
** TextBox
** Line
** Table
** Header
** Footer
** Lists
** Charts
* Each widget should have a clear and intuitive *icon or label*.
* Enable *drag-and-drop* functionality for each widget from the Toolbox into the central *designer canvas*.
* When a widget (e.g., Line) is *dropped* onto the canvas:
** A default representation of that widget should be created in the designer.
** For example:
*** Dropping *Line* creates a line.
*** Dropping *Table* creates a placeholder table with sample rows/columns.
*** Dropping *TextBox* shows a default text field (e.g., "Enter Text").
* Ensure visual *feedback during dragging* (e.g., highlight drop zone).
* Make sure the dropped widgets are *selectable* and *moveable* within the designer area.
* Maintain a consistent and intuitive *UI/UX* for interacting with the toolbox and widgets.

fields.description:
*Problem  Overview :* 

As per the current Implementation , when the user is assigned with multiple action parallelly to one single record, all the actions are shown as separate rows , in simple one record is shown in multiple rows just because it us asked for multiple action 

*Proposed Solution :* 

If the user is requested for multiple actions which starts from one trigger action it must be shown as one record.

In the Action column the label must be shown as *MULTIPLE* along with an *information button* (Same as in *Document type Screen  DOC NAMING SECTION )*

Upon click on the information button, all the requested actions must be requested must be listed

*User Story :* 

# As a user who is assigned with multiple actions , i must be shown all the actions as one record, so that i will not be confused.
# As system , the system must shown as MULTIPLE in the action column if the user is assigned with multiple actions parallelly, so that the user can differentiate
# As system , the system must show the user a information button in the same column which consists of the requested actions, so that the requested actions can be listed for view purpose
# As a user, i must be able to click the information button and see the requested action, so that i can get an understanding pf the requested actions

# As a user , i must be shown with an empty space  upon my click on the Add Data Set button in the list view , so that i can do the dedicated functions
# As a user i must be able to see a dropdown where all the created datasets are shown, so that i can select one of those for further needs
# As a user i must be given with the data set adding option in the dropdown , so that i can add another data set to the system .
# As a user , i must be redirect to another screen upon my click on the Data Source in the drop down , so that i can do further function
# As a user , i must be shown with an empty space  upon my click on the Data Source in the drop down , so that i can do further function
# As a user, i must be given with three spaces to add Basic details (Name and Description), Add the column headers and add the data to the added tables, so that i can add the details properly
# In the basic information section , all two fields are mandatory and must be applicable with all the character limitations
# In the Header adding section , there must be Add button to add the header.
# Upon click on that, As system , the system must provide a space to add all the relevant details, Data Source Header type (Dropdown) and Description (Multiline input), so that the user can add the data.
# Upon click on the Header type dropdown , As system , the system must provide all the data type to the user, so that the user can set the data type correctly.
# The header adding space must have a Save ad Cancel button, upon click on save the header must be saved and cancel, the space must be removed.(Both the execution must be done only after the user confirmation, therefore a confirmation message box must be given)
# Upon Save or Cancel (Mentioned in Pt 10), the user must be redirected to the Data set adding space.
# In the header adding section all the previously added headed of that particular data set must be shown along with Delete/Edit and Drag and drop function, so that the user can do the respective function.
# Upon click on the delete button , the header must be deleted (only after the user confirmation).
# Upon click on Edit button , the Header adding dialog box must be shown to the user with all the added data
# By click on the drag button and moving the cursor , the user must be able to move the position of the headers.
# All the points mentioned above (14/15/16), can be achieved in the header level only, if the columns are added with data these function must be disabled.
# The 3rd Section is the place where the user add data to the added headers and create a table, upon click on the add button a space must be provided to add the data to the headers same as the 2nd section.
# All the validations mentioned for the 2nd section header adding space are applicable for this data set adding space.
# In the Data Set section , each row of data must be given with the menu to edit and delete the row, so that the user can execute Update and delete function.
# Both the Delete and Edit function of the data set section is similar to the 2nd section (Functions and Validations)
# All these will be stored to the system upon click on the main save button (Create Data Set) and will be cleared upon click on the cancel button (Both the function upon user confirmation)
